_provider_help: Set llm_provider to 'openrouter' to use FREE OpenRouter models for text-based actions (code_helper, dev_agent, web_search, etc.). Set to 'gemini' to use Gemini for everything. Voice cloning with ELEVENLABS_API_KEY gives true voice cloning; without it, local pitch-shift approximation is used.
